name: codebase-assessment
description: Assess an app built with an AI coding tool and get a Ship, Harden, Rebuild, or Retire verdict with file-level findings.

interface.longDescription: Checks an app built mostly with an AI coding tool (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, Cursor, Claude Code) across RoleModel's eight Assessment Areas and returns a Ship, Harden, Rebuild, or Retire verdict with file-level findings and an architecture map. It reads the code on your computer and makes no network calls of its own.
defaultPrompt: Run a codebase assessment on this repo
Is this app ready for real users?
Is it safe to take payments with this app?
